fields.title: PMP® Exam Prep & Practical Delivery
fields.tagline: Pass your exam on the first attempt and run projects with confidence.
fields.overview: We walk you through everything needed to pass the PMP exam without memorizing useless trivia. More importantly, we connect every concept to daily job realities: how to build realistic schedules, manage difficult stakeholders, and keep your project from falling behind.
fields.deliverables:
35 official contact hours certificate required for PMI application
One-on-one review of your application experience before submission
Full access to 1,000+ realistic practice exam questions
Ready-to-use project charter and stakeholder register templates

fields.title: Project Management Fundamentals (CAPM®)
fields.tagline: A structured foundation for early-career managers and coordinators.
fields.overview: Designed for team leads, coordinators, and recent graduates who want to run projects systematically. You will learn the core lifecycle of a project—from initial scoping and task assignment to risk tracking and final project closeout.
fields.deliverables:
23 PMI-approved contact hours certificate
Step-by-step guidance for writing clear work breakdown structures
Introductory risk log and issue tracking spreadsheets
CAPM exam practice questions and test-taking strategy guide

fields.title: Agile Delivery & Scrum Master Training
fields.tagline: Run focused sprints and keep your team delivering on time.
fields.overview: Many teams adopt Agile on paper but still struggle with chaotic backlogs and missed deadlines. This course shows you how Scrum works when applied properly. You will learn how to estimate effort accurately, run 15-minute standups that stay on point, and handle shifting client priorities.
fields.deliverables:
Full preparation for PSM I / CSM certification exams
Hands-on board configuration in Jira and Trello
Sprint planning, daily scrum, and retrospective facilitation guides
Practical techniques for managing scope changes without team burnout

fields.title: Site Management & Contractor Supervision
fields.tagline: Keep physical builds on schedule, verify work quality, and handle claims.
fields.overview: Tailored for site engineers, quantity surveyors, and project directors overseeing physical works. Learn how to track progress on site, document daily occurrences to prevent dispute claims, manage sub-contractor delays, and navigate standard contract conditions.
fields.deliverables:
Plain-English guide to FIDIC conditions and contractor notices
Standard daily site diary and milestone tracking templates
Clear procedures for handling delay notifications and variations
Taking-Over and defect liability inspection checklists

fields.title: Project Cost Engineering & Budget Control
fields.tagline: Catch budget overruns early and forecast final costs with accuracy.
fields.overview: Most project budgets fail quietly before anyone realizes there is a problem. In this workshop, you will learn how to build solid cost baselines, track true labor and materials spending against actual progress, and present clean financial reports to executive leaders.
fields.deliverables:
Excel cost tracking template with automated variance formulas
Step-by-step Earned Value calculations made simple
Checklists for evaluating contractor payment certificates
Executive monthly cost report format ready for board presentation
